title: Évariste Galois — Mathematical Works (1897): Modern English Reader with GPT Critical Notes / Œuvres mathématiques (1897) : lecteur anglais moderne et notes critiques GPT
description:
Open the complete linked English reader or download it directly.

This fixed English edition translates the complete substantive content of Évariste Galois's Œuvres mathématiques (Paris: Gauthier-Villars et fils, 1897), covering physical source-PDF pages 001–096 / W01–W11. It includes front matter, Émile Picard's Introduction, every collected work and fragment, historical notes, formulas, contents, and colophon; figures and blank-page topology are accounted for. The main translation preserves the printed historical claim. Concise adjacent GPT Critical Notes state corrections, qualifications, consequences, and open readings; exhaustive proof, propagation, and provenance evidence accompanies the release. The completed post-P13 program records 9 repaired, 8 proved, 2 rejected, and 2 unresolved tasks, with exactly five cumulative open readings.

Historical author: Évariste Galois. Edition identity and maintenance: Manuscript Typesetting Project. Post-P13 web research and mathematical certificates were supplied by OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol in Pro mode. The modern-English translation, critical integration, DOI release engineering, and independent QA were supplied by OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol in Ultra mode. No human translator is asserted.

Stable English concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21924301. Exact English release DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21924302. French source-language concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21923856. Global project: 10.5281/zenodo.20393488. Repository: github.com/KokunoYumeto/evariste-galois-en.

DataCite intent: the English concept IsTranslationOf the French concept, and the French concept HasTranslation the English concept. Because Zenodo does not currently expose those relation values, this record uses isDerivedFrom the French concept as the machine-readable fallback; the exact relation directions are preserved in the README and evidence sidecar. The separate isPartOf relation identifies the global project only.

The 1897 historical work is public-domain source material. CC0 1.0 applies to the modern translation, critical apparatus, typesetting, metadata, scripts, and evidence only to the extent the Manuscript Typesetting Project owns the relevant rights. It does not relicense third-party scans, catalogue metadata, or witness artifacts. Release closure uses source replay, model/agent checks, deterministic builds, rendered inspection, hashes, and disclosed unresolved items; no human-review gate is imposed.
